english.scenario: Improve a deterministic allocation plan against weighted targets and capacity constraints.
english.consequence: Poor plans leave high-priority demand uncovered while consuming scarce capacity.
english.why_long: The agent can repeatedly diagnose uncovered targets, rebalance capacity, and submit improved plans.

chinese.scenario: 改进同时受加权目标与容量约束的确定性分配计划。
chinese.consequence: 低质量计划会遗漏高优先级需求，同时占用稀缺容量。
chinese.why_long: 智能体可反复诊断未覆盖目标、调整容量并提交改进方案。
